description: Metal Aircraft Corporation G-2-W Flamingo c/n 11, NC9487, the aircraft Jimmie Angel landed on Auyantepui on 9 October 1937 while exploring Angel Falls; recovered by the FAV in 1970, restored and displayed outdoors in front of the Ciudad Bolívar terminal, where it has suffered weather and vandalism (tail damaged by a vehicle c.2000). Photographed 2002 and 2013-2017; a 2022 virtualglobetrotting pin exists at the airport.
